scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,desktop -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @echodeck/server" "npm run dev -w @echodeck/desktop"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @echodeck/server" "npm run dev -w @poio/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @echodeck/server && npm run build -w @echodeck/desktop && npm run build -w @poio/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @echodeck/server && npm run test -w @echodeck/desktop && npm run test -w @poio/web
